details:
In the world, i really want know if other can see me or not. Because everyone has different safetly modes, so one blocked shaders, other blocked avatar, again other blocked animations. And also even full block possible.

This is very important due interaction with others. If i want wave and talk with someone, it must not useless action because other blocked you by default on avatars.
I'm bad hearing, but this goes also for deaf people. Both are very set on visuals, and that means possible to use hand writing or keyboard feature. (base avatar can show hands, lucky - but also with incorrect height. If you use small avatar or very big one, other will look wrong at you.)

So there must some feedback possible. We have already feedback icons for sound and mics blocking, but there is not clearly visible for avatar part.
Because:
- if shaders are blocked, you cannot use handwriting or keyboard function
- Some avatars will look very weird without shaders (solid colored) or even invisible, or looks ugly due extra layers on your body / face.
- if extra animations are blocked, you cannot show animations to other
- if avatar is blocked, they cannot see you how you looked

It's also very important to know if avatar is blocked, you know they will mostly ignore you. If you're blocked, then you need know too.

Otherwise it's more strange interaction with others, and that is not good! You're wasting your energy on it because you don't know why other cannot see you... and that makes also feeling bad.
title: Need feedback from other due different safetly modes
